stem:
The two figures shown are congruent, and one-fourth of each figure is shaded.

Which statement about the shaded parts of these figures is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The area of the shaded part of Figure M is greater than the area of the shaded part of Figure N.

options.label: B
options.text: The area of the shaded part of Figure M is less than the area of the shaded part of Figure N.

options.label: C
options.text: The area of the shaded part of Figure M is equal to the area of the shaded part of Figure N.

visual_elements: Two rectangles labeled Figure M and Figure N. Figure M is divided into 4 equal vertical sections with the second section shaded gray. Figure N is divided into 4 equal horizontal sections with the third section shaded gray.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding that congruent figures with the same fraction shaded have equal shaded areas; simple comparison of area concepts.
